notes: ROMVERSE physically observed an SM-S928B reporting codename e3q over an authorized USB ADB connection on 2026-09-04; all bounded read-only identity and health probes completed without timeout.
Google Play catalog evidence resolved the retail identity as Galaxy S24 Ultra and was stored in a tamper-evident local identity receipt.
This evidence validates discovery and read-only diagnostics only. It does not validate another SM-S928 variant or grant build, download-mode, recovery, signing, or flash authority.
